observations.behavior: The credential validation for Ticketmaster no longer raises an exception when the connection fails; instead, it returns a tuple indicating failure and an unreachable message. The HTTP 429 and 500 status codes are also treated as unreachable. The HTTP error message no longer includes the full URL, which could expose sensitive information.
observations.posthog_connection: This could prevent credential probing from leaking sensitive information, such as the full URL, in the error message. It could also prevent the credential validation from raising an exception, which could cause the credential validation to fail and prevent the warehouse ingestion from proceeding.
